decisions.reason: Garage door operators sit right next to the firm's core garage door expertise and have a page of their own, so the firm can read early results and keep improving them.

A solid wood sectional door uses materials less central to the firm's metal-fabrication knowledge and is only mentioned on the site, but it fits the one-source range and customization strategy, so the firm keeps it for now while watching it.
The remote-control operator builds on the operator line and related electronics knowledge, though its overlap with Product A makes consolidation somewhat possible.
Glazed industrial sectional doors draw directly on the firm's industrial door know-how, but with several overlapping glazed variants this one may be merged into the others.
The insulated glazed door applies the firm's thermal-solutions expertise and meets regulatory energy demands, giving it clear value and strong absorptive fit.
A dedicated page signals that this is the flagship glazed industrial door, and it rests firmly on core competencies.
